name: Live notifications
description: Quiet, rotating Home Assistant notifications over your existing screensaver. Manual placement, a subtle roller transition, and a sample-data preview.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Show during screensaver
settings.description: A passive overlay over any existing screensaver. Does not change screensaver settings.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Shown in this order when eligible. At most 16 unique source entities across enabled rows; shared sources count once.

fields.title: Entity
fields.description: Supplies the name, icon, value and condition by default.

fields.title: Custom label
fields.description: Leave empty to use the entity's friendly name.

fields.title: Show when
fields.description: Unavailable, unknown or missing sources never match, including Does not equal.

fields.title: Compare with
fields.description: Exact case-sensitive HA state (for example on), or a plain number such as 25.5.

fields.title: Override sources
fields.description: Optional icon, value and visibility sources. Empty entity picks use the primary entity.

fields.title: Value attribute
fields.description: Optional exact top-level attribute name. Scalar text, boolean or number only; no templates or paths.

fields.title: Condition attribute
fields.description: Optional exact top-level scalar attribute. Available checks this source too.

settings.title: Transition
settings.description: A clipped, subtle 350 ms roll. Choose None for no motion; Android's disabled animations are respected too.

settings.title: Anchor
settings.description: Manual placement only. The plugin cannot detect or automatically avoid clocks or widgets.

settings.title: Horizontal offset
settings.description: Positive moves right; negative moves left. KS keeps the chip on screen.

settings.title: Vertical offset
settings.description: Positive moves down; negative moves up.

settings.title: Chip width
settings.description: Fixed width across notifications, capped by available screen space. Follows KS Scale UI.

settings.title: Preview sample notifications
settings.description: Cycles labeled sample data, even with no configured entities. Stops when turned off, the settings page closes, the screen turns off, or after two minutes. Does not start or replace a screensaver.
